description: A/B treatment: swap in the SPLIT command body (contract in the command, Phases 0–9 in a reference the agent must Read) and run the same /pan:focus-design --spike; assert the same artefact and record cost.
why: Reality check RC19 / plan item R21: five emitted command bodies exceed the Agent Skills recommendation; the August note said a split changes what the agent reads and when, so it must be measured, not assumed. Same seed, same prompt, same mode (--spike: the cheapest full pass); the comparison is artefact presence plus the per-step cost the runner records from claude -p. Run --repeat 2 with both scenarios in one invocation so reps interleave. This is the treatment arm; the swap step happens before the model runs and reports the body size before and after.

steps.why: The variant lives in harness/variants/ until the A/B decides; the swap rewrites ~/.claude/ to ./.claude/ exactly as the local installer does.

steps.prompt: /pan:focus-design "add a --json flag to bin/cli.js so that `tiny add` and `tiny greet` print a JSON object ({\"result\": ...}) instead of plain text, with tests" --spike
steps.why: Identical assertion to the control arm. A missing spec here and not there is the finding: the agent did not read the procedure, or read it and lost the thread.
